faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is 26 September 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years for all the posts advertised by WCD Odisha. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for WCD Odisha jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard (Matriculation) from a recognized board to be eligible for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper positions.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 7 vacancies are available for the posts of Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper in this recruitment drive by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this WCD Odisha recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for WCD Odisha Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions will primarily involve Document Verification followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the candidates' qualifications and other relevant criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a government job or a contractual position?
faq.answer: The job type for these Anganwadi Worker and Helper positions is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the department.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website for engagement is also provided there.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The jobs are located in Nuagaon, Odisha, with the pincode 770035, under the Women and Child Development Department Odisha.
